venue: Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Punta Cana
text: Marcos and his team were absolutely incredible. Every single photo captured the emotion of our day perfectly. We cannot recommend Soul Pictures enough!
Usamos Soul Pictures para nuestra boda destino y quedamos sin palabras. Las fotos son mágicas, profesionales y llenas de amor. ¡Gracias infinitas!

We didn’t want stiff wedding photos  we wanted real moments, personality, and fun. Marcos captured exactly that. This photo perfectly reflects who we are together: relaxed, playful, and completely in the moment. He made us feel comfortable from the very beginning and somehow managed to capture every emotion naturally without ever making anything feel forced. The final gallery was beyond beautiful  emotional, elegant, and full of life. These are memories we’ll cherish forever.”

We had looked at dozens of photographers before finding Soul Pictures, and nothing came close. Marcos has this extraordinary gift for disappearing into the background during the ceremony  you forget he's even there  and then the gallery arrives and you realize he was everywhere, catching every tear, every laugh, every quiet glance between us. Our photos look like they belong in a magazine, yet they feel deeply personal. Three years later and we still look through them constantly. Truly the best investment we made for our wedding.

I was the most nervous bride you've ever seen. Cameras in my face have always made me freeze up and look stiff, so I told Marcos this during our first call. He completely put me at ease and said 'just forget I'm there.' I laughed  how could I forget the photographer? But somehow I did. He moved like a shadow, quiet and patient, and the results are extraordinary. I'm laughing, I'm crying, I'm dancing — looking completely like myself, not like someone posing. That's the magic of Soul Pictures. I've already referred three friends.

We flew our families in from six different countries for our destination wedding, and the logistics were overwhelming. But every time I stressed about something, I would remember that at least the photography was handled and handled perfectly. Marcos arrived hours before the ceremony to scout the light, communicated with our coordinator seamlessly, and delivered our full gallery in record time. The images are breathtaking. Golden light, turquoise water, and genuine emotion in every frame. Worth every single dollar, and then some.

As French expats, we were worried about finding a photographer who would understand our aesthetic  we wanted something cinematic, moody, and elegant rather than the typical bright tropical resort style. Marcos completely understood. He scouted locations with us beforehand, discussed our vision in detail, and delivered a gallery that looks like frames from a French film set in the Caribbean. The editing is subtle and sophisticated. Several guests asked if we had hired a cinematographer. We are beyond proud of these images and keep them displayed throughout our home.

Our wedding day moved faster than we ever expected. Suddenly it was over and we barely remembered half of it  that's just how weddings go. But then the gallery came and it all came flooding back. Every detail we missed in the moment, captured perfectly. My grandmother dancing. My father holding back tears during the vows. My husband's face when he saw me for the first time. Marcos documented all of it with such discretion and artistry. Looking at those photos now feels like living it again. That gift is priceless.

We were honestly nervous about hiring a photographer while planning everything from abroad, especially because we wanted someone who could capture both the emotional moments and the energy of our wedding naturally  not overly posed or forced. Marcos exceeded every expectation.

From the very beginning he was easy to communicate with, professional, and genuinely interested in understanding what mattered most to us. On the wedding day, he blended in perfectly with our guests and somehow managed to capture moments we didn’t even realize were happening.

When we received the gallery, it felt incredibly personal and real. The emotions, the lighting, the atmosphere  everything looked beautiful without feeling over-edited. One of our favorite photos is this one during the fireworks with our daughter; it perfectly captures the happiness and chaos of the night in the best possible way.

Several friends and family members have already asked us for his contact information after seeing the photos. We truly couldn’t have chosen a better photographer for our wedding in Punta Cana.

We didn’t want our wedding photos to look like a staged photoshoot  we wanted them to feel like us. Fun, emotional, imperfect at times, and real. That’s exactly why working with Marcos was such an amazing experience.

Neither of us are professional models and we were worried about feeling awkward in front of the camera, but Marcos has this very calm and natural way of working that instantly makes you feel comfortable. Nothing ever felt forced. Some of our favorite moments happened when we weren’t even paying attention to the camera at all.

What we love most about the gallery is that every image has personality. Some are romantic, some are emotional, and others  like this one  are completely spontaneous and hilarious. Looking back at them feels like reliving the energy of the entire day instead of just looking at pretty poses.

If you’re looking for someone who captures genuine moments instead of overly scripted wedding photos, Soul Pictures is absolutely the right choice

“From the very first moment we spoke with Marcos, we felt an instant connection. We were planning our dream wedding in Punta Cana, and it was incredibly important for us to find someone who would not only create beautiful photos, but also truly understand our story and make us feel comfortable being completely ourselves.

Marcos did that and so much more. We never felt like the cameras were intrusive or that anything was forced. Everything flowed naturally, effortlessly, and authentically. He captured every emotion with so much sensitivity  the quiet looks, the nerves before the ceremony, the tears during the vows, and all the joy we experienced throughout the day.

When we received the gallery, we both cried. Not only because the photos were beautiful, but because they genuinely tell our love story in such an honest and artistic way. This particular image became one of our favorites because it perfectly reflects how that moment felt: intimate, peaceful, and full of love.

We are deeply grateful we found Soul Pictures. These memories will stay with us forever

We eloped to Punta Cana with just eight of our closest people, wanting something intimate and low-key. Soul Pictures was recommended by our resort coordinator and it turned out to be the single best decision we made. Marcos arrived with a calm, unhurried energy that immediately set the tone for the whole day. He found light and angles we never would have noticed. He captured the laughter during the tiny ceremony, the toast on the terrace, the barefoot dancing at sunset. Our gallery has over three hundred images and every single one is frame-worthy. For an intimate elopement, we truly felt like the most important wedding of the year.

Llevábamos años soñando con una boda en el Caribe y cuando por fin llegó el día, queríamos que todo quedara grabado para siempre. Un amigo nos recomendó a Soul Pictures y desde el primer momento supimos que era la persona ideal. Marcos tiene una sensibilidad especial para capturar emociones sin que te des cuenta. Nuestras fotos no parecen poses ni escenas armadas  parecen momentos reales, porque lo son. La luz del atardecer en la playa, los colores, la naturalidad de cada imagen... es todo lo que pedíamos y mucho más. Los llevaremos en el corazón por el resto de nuestras vidas.

I planned our entire destination wedding from London, which meant trusting vendors I had never met in person. Most of them caused some level of stress along the way — but never Marcos. From our very first video call he was organized, warm, and completely transparent about what to expect. He sent a detailed shot list, confirmed every timeline, and even checked in the week before to make sure we had everything covered. On the day itself he was a calming presence for everyone around him. When the gallery arrived I sat down and cried for twenty minutes straight. He captured things I had no idea were happening — my mother straightening my veil, my best friend whispering something in my ear seconds before I walked down the aisle, my husband mouthing 'you're so beautiful' during the ceremony. These are the moments that make a life. Soul Pictures gave them back to us forever.

Nunca pensé que unas fotos pudieran hacerme sentir tanto. Cuando abrí la galería que nos mandó Marcos, tuve que cerrar la laptop y tomarme unos minutos porque me abrumé de la emoción. Cada imagen cuenta una parte de nuestra historia  la forma en que Mateo me miró cuando llegué al altar, el abrazo de mi papá antes de entregarme, los niños de la familia corriendo descalzos por la playa durante la recepción. Marcos tiene un ojo único para los detalles humanos, para los instantes que duran solo un segundo pero que significan todo. Contratarlo fue la mejor decisión que tomamos en toda la planificación de nuestra boda, y se lo decimos a cualquier pareja que nos pregunta. Soul Pictures no solo toma fotos  preserva emociones para siempre.
